summary: PR #296 (ship boost) completed using the mitmproxy capture of SpeedUpShipConstructionUsingBoostGauge. The endpoint POSTs shipId/clientDateTime/accessToken and replies with the full upgraded ship under ShipService/SpeedUpShipConstructionUsingBoostGauge/Ship (plus User), not a Success envelope. The fake server now returns that shape; the client parses the reply into shipByUserId/rooms/researches and _shipRecord accepts both GetShipByUserId and SpeedUpShipConstructionUsingBoostGauge wrappers. Capability inventory marks the ship boost and orchestrator methods as mocked-test.

contract_status_changes.contract: Recognise the live ship boost reply
contract_status_changes.before: fake returned a Success envelope; client ignored the reply body
contract_status_changes.after: fake returns the full upgraded ship; client parses ShipService/SpeedUpShipConstructionUsingBoostGauge/Ship into ship state

residual_risks: The User element present in the live reply is not consumed by the fake or client; only Ship/Rooms/Researches are mirrored.
Auth material from the capture is not preserved in any artifact.
